sample_size.notes: Forms after an uptrend; bearish reversal signal on breakdown.

target_calculation.description: Target = lowest valley - (highest peak - lowest valley). Project downward from breakdown below the lowest valley.

ultimate_low_method.definition: Lowest price after downward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to decline 5% below the lowest valley after breakdown.

failure_rate.notes: Only break-even (5%) value extracted from PDF review; full curve not captured. Reproducer should query chapter 47 for 10%/15%/20%.

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Very tight range — both markets resolve quickly (~35 days). This is a FAST pattern.

performance_statistics.best_market: bear (24% decline, 4% BE failure — strong bearish reversal)
performance_statistics.speed_characteristic: One of the FASTEST reversal patterns (~35 days to ultimate low vs 51+ for triple tops).

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 47, p707-720.

Legacy digitized file three_falling_peaks_digitized.json has detection_signature but post_breakout_measurement ONLY has lookahead_bars: 252 — NO failure rate, sample, target. This file fills that gap.
